cover_letter_text:
Hello Aaron,

I am applying for the Civil Engineer / Design Engineer role at Newton Denny Chapelle, advertised on SEEK. Your advert asks what project experience I would bring and how I could contribute in my first three months.

My most relevant project experience is the design work in my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, completed in February 2026. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings on a community hall renovation and prepared progress reports on residential subdivision finishing works. In my first three months I can help prepare and check drawings and documentation for your subdivision, road and stormwater projects, and support construction.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Lismore or Casuarina for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a call?

Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: The option that names a graduate temporary work visa (Subclass 485). If the list has no such option, choose the temporary visa option that has no restriction on hours or industry.
